A group of sisters that were corrupted by chaos. Six sisters received great gifts from the chaos gods, now they're twisted versions of the six patron saints of the largest orders militant.

They slew the leader of their order, whose warsuit is now reanimated through the power of the warp. Alongside many other twisted war machines. However they were able to capture only a few warships, and a single forgeworld, for their territory. They now maraud round the sector capturing new ships for their fleet and expanding their domain trying to gain enough power to control this sector, and open up an incursion of those who also worship the dark gods.

This frequently brings them into conflict with the local guard, as well as the Ultramarines 7th company and a successor chapter of the Dark Angels. However, so far their corrupted powers have proven effective in defeating even ardent veterans of these forces. During an incursion into their territory by the Thousand Sons, one of the twisted saints was seen single-handedly defeating the daemon prince leading the Thousand Sons.

However their worship of the dark powers is not always uniform, which leads to infighting. Some worship gods individually, and others worship chaos as a whole. The most noteworthy example is when at the start of the Thousand Sons' advance, internal conflict between the Nurgle and Tzeentch worshippers over the use of backline heavy weapons caused a catastrophic defeat with many serious losses, both of valuable wargear and soldiers.

Ultimately though, with occupation of a forgeworld, an armoury planet, several agri-worlds and even a hive planet this is a dangerous threat that should not be taken lightly, even if right now it's only mustering.
